mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of robust industrial production (INDPRO > 115), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 115.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.5% triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.2% indicates expanding labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 0%), weak economic activity reduces corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong supply-side expansion, boosting corporate output and profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both rise from prior period
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise from prior period.
